So neutral 120 BP with Life Orb. Garchomp could outspeed (up to 169). Make It Rain likely does big damage (~60-80%?). Garchomp HP ~183-215. 120 BP Life Orb from 185 SpA vs Garchomp's likely ~100 SpD: roughly 2HKO, possibly close to OHKO on frail spreads. Nasty Plot risky if Garchomp outspeeds and hits — but Garchomp's STAB Earthquake hits Gholdengo? No, Gholdengo is Steel/Ghost; Earthquake can't hit Ghost. Garchomp's moves unknown; Fire Fang/Stone Edge could hit. Make It Rain is the safe strong option.
